name: Vigilant-Vole
description: Vigilant Vole is a lightweight, self-hosted uptime monitor written in Rust - an Uptime Kuma alternative in one small image (about 18 MB compressed, a few MB of RAM). Monitors: HTTP(S) (basic, OAuth2 or client-certificate auth), keyword, JSON query, TCP port, ping, DNS, push/heartbeat, Docker container, WebSocket, TLS, certificate and domain expiry, NTP, Steam game servers, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC, SMTP, RADIUS and SNMP, plus groups. Alerts go to 24 notification services (Discord, Slack, Telegram, email, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, Teams, Matrix, PagerDuty and more), and Apprise covers 90+ others, with retries, reminders, escalation and flap detection. Also included: public status pages with custom domains, incidents and badges; maintenance windows; multi-user roles with two-factor login; remote probe agents that confirm an outage from another network before alerting; Docker label auto-discovery; a REST API, config as code (YAML/JSON) and an Uptime Kuma importer; Prometheus metrics with Kuma-compatible names. English and Norwegian interface. Setup: open the WebUI after the first start and create the admin account. Everything lives in one SQLite file under /data (appdata). Map the Docker socket only if you want Docker container monitors or label discovery.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SQLite database, session key and backups. Ownership is set to PUID:PGID on every start.

paths.name: Docker socket (optional)
paths.description: Only needed for Docker container monitors and label auto-discovery. Leave empty to disable.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: Web interface, API, status pages and /metrics.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

variables.name: VV_TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Set to 1 when the WebUI is only reachable through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik) that sets X-Forwarded-* headers.

variables.name: VV_CONFIG_FILE
variables.description: Optional path (inside the container, e.g. /data/vigilant.yml) to a YAML/JSON config file merged into the database on every start.
